rv.q: It is delightfully playful, although there is not quite enough charge underneath.
What a stylish, silly and surprisingly sophisticated night at the theatre.
If you're looking for a fun night out where nothing is taken too seriously with a bit of a mystery thrown in, this is the play for you!

cn.t: Emma Rice's playful adaptation of Hitchcock's thriller wins over critics with its whimsical humor and intelligent reimagining, transforming the spy classic into a joyful, crowd-pleasing comedy that delights audiences.
